paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
model_annotation: The figure consists of two vertically stacked line plots illustrating training rewards for different methods on Easy and Hard training sets. The x-axis, labeled "Steps," has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at regular intervals of 100. The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," has a linear scale, with tick labels varying between plots but generally ranging from 0.0 to 0.4. In the Easy Training Set plot, there are two lines: one in teal for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and one in red for "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." Both lines start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with the teal line reaching approximately 0.35 and the red line reaching approximately 0.4 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set plot, there are also two lines: one in teal for "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and one in red for "Llama-LUFFY-Hard." The teal line starts near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.05, then declines back toward 0.0 after step 150, while the red line shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500.
